[center][font=Georgia][b]More trees, more fruit, and more recipes for Stardew Valley Kalash's More Fruit Trees is a mod for Stardew Valley that expands the game's farming content by adding new fruit trees, previously unseen fruits, and additional recipes to use them.[/b][/font][/center]

[center][/center]
[center][font=Georgia][b]This mod doesn't just add a single tree, but introduces several new varieties that integrate naturally into the game experience.[/b][/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Georgia][b]Each tree produces its own fruit, expanding the options for cultivation, sale, and artisanal processing.[/b][/font][/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/N65mLcjC/Page-Divider.png[/img][/center]
[center][font=Georgia][b]VANILLA TREE PACK [/b][/font][/center]
[center][spoiler][font=Georgia][b]Welcome to the new "Vanilla Tree Pack," designed for players who love ConcernedApe's style. These new trees are based on the game's original fruit trees.
[/b][/font]
[font=Georgia][b][b][img]https://i.ibb.co/N65mLcjC/Page-Divider.png[/img] Don't like my sprites? Use these![/b][/b][/font]
[font=Georgia][b]
[img width=550]https://i.ibb.co/ZQBj9DY/2026-05-19-111334-Dibujo-3.png[/img]
This new pack is found in the options of this mod; it comes disabled by default.[/b][/font][/spoiler]
[/center]

[center][b]New fruits with their own items and integration into the game. [/b][/center]

[center][b]Additional recipes that use the added fruits. [/b][/center]

[center][b]Balanced integration with normal game progression. [/b][/center]

[center][b]Compatible with version 1.6.[/b][/center]

[center][b]Trees can be obtained and cultivated as part of the normal flow of the game, respecting the visual style and consistency of the original world.[/b][/center]


[center][b][b]The mod is designed to feel like a natural expansion of the base content, ideal for those looking for more variety without altering the essence of the experience. [/b][/b][/center]


[center][b][b]This mod is fully developed on a mobile device, but it has been tested on a computer.[/b][/b][/center]

[center]Big technical update! Hi everyone, it's me, kalásh, that's right, I'm still around! This update is packed with changes, so here's the full list: [/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/N65mLcjC/Page-Divider.png[/img][/center]
[center]Attention translators, I've had to reorganize the i18n files again. Don't worry, I've now created a file called "Changelogs" where you can see all the changes in the i18n files. [/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/N65mLcjC/Page-Divider.png[/img][/center]
[center]All the fruit tree names have been removed; that's right—after looking into it, I agree with you. They are completely useless and cause a funny conflict with the Generic Mod Config Menu. [/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/N65mLcjC/Page-Divider.png[/img][/center]
[center]The fruit tree sprites have been greatly improved, especially the yuzu tree; I love it. [/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/N65mLcjC/Page-Divider.png[/img][/center]
[center]The descriptions of the Saplings in English have been significantly improved. That's right, as a token of my love for the community, I've made them virtually identical to the vanilla descriptions. [/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/N65mLcjC/Page-Divider.png[/img][/center]
[center]The spawn rate of wild cacao on Ginger Island has been reduced from 1-3 per day to 0-2 per day. This is to avoid optimization issues and also to prevent your farm on the island from becoming overcrowded with wild cacao after a while.[/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/N65mLcjC/Page-Divider.png[/img][/center]
[center]I didn't want the update to be just technical content, so I added a few new features[/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/N65mLcjC/Page-Divider.png[/img][/center]
[center]New chocolate: Hazelnut Chocolate—crafted by combining 2 hazelnuts with 1 cocoa in the chocolate maker [/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/N65mLcjC/Page-Divider.png[/img][/center]
[center]The Mangrove Sapling is now obtained after the first green rain; if you have an ongoing save, don't worry—you'll be able to buy it when the green rain returns [/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/N65mLcjC/Page-Divider.png[/img][/center]
[center]The Walnut Sapling can now be obtained at the Raccoon Wife's shop[/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/N65mLcjC/Page-Divider.png[/img][/center]
[center]More customization options have been added to the mod settings; in fact, I've reorganized that entire section[/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/N65mLcjC/Page-Divider.png[/img][/center]
[center]Now you'll be able to buy the soups from my mod at Mellie's shop, and the Earth Crystal at the usual shop.  [/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/N65mLcjC/Page-Divider.png[/img][/center]
[center]That's all for this update—grab a coffee and enjoy a laid-back life c: [/center]
[center][img]https://i.ibb.co/N65mLcjC/Page-Divider.png[/img][/center]
[center]- DeidadKalásh [/center]

[center]Snake Fruit Tree, a unique palm tree that produces a peculiar fruit in summer.[/center]
[center]New recipes![/center]
[center]Orange juice, a very sweet and much-loved juice[/center]
[center]Orange tart, a perfect tart[/center]
[center]Pomegranate tart, a real treat[/center]
[center]Cherry tea, Caroline loves this[/center]
[center]Achacha mousse, experiment with this new fruit[/center]
[center]Mango curry, a delight with a perfect consistency[/center]
[center]A lot of changes to buffs, fruit trees, etc.[/center]
[center]A bug with the plum tree was fixed; it previously bore fruit in spring.[/center]

[center]- All the code in the fruit trees was reorganized; previously, one folder with three .json files was required for each tree, now only one .json file is needed for each tree[/center]

[center]- New items added: Cassava, Cassava seeds, Cooked cassava, Cassava smoothie, Cassava extract, Cashew oil, Pine nut jam, Explorer's elixir, Rubber, Rubber tree seed[/center]

[center]The description of the nut was shortened so that it is not so large and descriptive, making it more similar to the descriptions in the base game.[/center]

[center]- Three new cards have been added, which will be unlocked after fulfilling certain in-game requirements.[/center]

[center]- The trigger for the "MrPumpkin'sGift" card has been completely fixed; it now works perfectly and should no longer have any problems.[/center]

[center]- A jacket has been added that can be combined with the red scarf found in the character customization menu. This jacket will be delivered by mail after time has progressed in your game.[/center]

[center]- A menu has been added to the mod allowing you to disable or enable the mod's fruit trees, for greater customization and compatibility with other mods like Cornucopia.[/center]

[center]- The price of precooked meat in the Starfruit Hall has been corrected. Previously, it cost 100g, and 1500g in Joja Mart, which was ridiculously unbalanced. It will now cost 1000g in the Starfruit Hall.[/center]

[center]- The Summer Perfume sprite has been updated to give it a more natural and polished look.[/center]

[center]- A new crop has been added: Cassava can be purchased from the traveling vendor for 85g. It will grow in two in-game seasons: Spring and Autumn, taking 10 days to complete, and will yield a single harvest. Cassava was originally from a canceled mod I was working on, but put yourself in my shoes: if it's already difficult for me to maintain my main mod, "Kalash's More Fruit Trees," imagine having to maintain another large expansion.[/center]

[center] - The i18n file was compacted to avoid potential overloads on smapi due to unnecessary space.[/center]

[center]- Now you can park cocoa naturally on Ginger Island, this in order to make it more difficult to obtain the cocoa sprout.[/center]

[center] - The sale of cacao sprouts has changed: previously it was purchased for 35 units of mamoncillo, now it will be purchased for 6 units of cacao. This forces the player to first collect cacao on Ginger Island in order to later farm their own cacao.[/center]

[center]- It will no longer be necessary to sell the medicinal ointment and the bottle of gum to achieve perfection in the game.[/center]

[center]- The description of the bottle of gum was shortened to sound more natural.[/center]

[center]- A small adjustment was made to the description of the shadow fruit.[/center]

[center]- A small adjustment was made to the description of the tamarind to sound more natural.[/center]

[center]- A BIG adjustment was made to the description of the snack. Its description was excessively long.[/center]

[center]- The entire image system in the "Fruit Trees" folder was reorganized to avoid overloading smapi.[/center]

[center]- A new wild tree, "Rubber Tree," was added. The Rubber Tree can be purchased from the raccoon wife's shop. If you place a resin harvester on it, it will yield Rubber, which is useful for selling and crafting items.[/center]

[center]- Three new types of chocolate were added: white chocolate, Ruby chocolate, and a heart-shaped chocolate bar with strawberry filling.[/center]

[center]- A new fruit tree was added: the mamey tree, which can be purchased at the Ginger Island shop. The mamey tree will produce mamey, a tropical fruit added in this update.[/center]

[center]- The entire mod code was reorganized to be more efficient and organized.[/center]
